finding: All 15 completed tests lost WETH before gas in each of their ten paired observations. Changing persistence or an entry threshold does not remove that measured loss.
implementationFault: Previous epoch memory retained hypotheses, but not their detailed economic outcomes. The planner required new proposals even when no measured positive economics supported them.
boundary: Bounded quote research, not trades or proof of profitability.
